subject: Interim coverage path & evidence hand-off for SOC 2 during renewal
messages:
From: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 docs for renewal — coverage question

Hi Ben,

We’re preparing Acme Health’s renewal packet and need to confirm Redwood’s SOC 2 coverage for our procurement review. Two quick asks:

1) Can you share your latest SOC 2 Type II report (period covered + report date)?
2) If there’s a coverage gap between your last report and the new report date, are you able to provide a bridge letter or interim attestation that would satisfy our security gate through the renewal on 2027-08-31?

Procurement is asking whether a bridge (or signed interim attestation) can be provided and dated to cover until 2027-08-31. Our PO cutoff for this fiscal quarter is 2027-06-15.

If useful, we can hop on a quick call to walk through requirements — I’ve copied procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com).

Thanks,
Lisa
Lisa Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 docs for renewal — coverage question

Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and for looping procurement in. I’m attaching the most recent artifacts we can share now, and outlining a pragmatic path to cover your renewal window.

Summary / quick answers:
- Latest report: SOC 2 Type II (reporting period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31), final report date 2026-03-10. Attachment: soc2-type2-2025.pdf (redacted vendor-ready copy).
- Bridge: We can provide a signed bridge letter that confirms continued controls coverage from 2026-12-31 through 2027-08-31, subject to our legal sign-off. We typically issue bridge letters within 3–4 weeks of a request once the language is agreed.
- Interim attestation: For procurement gates that require more detail, we can produce a short interim attestation (one-page) describing controls in place as of the requested coverage period — draft can be shared earlier for review.

Planned deliverables and timing (proposed):
- Today: soc2-type2-2025.pdf (attached), procurement-checklist.xlsx (attached) — checklist maps our artifacts to common procurement questions.
- By 2027-06-03: interim-attestation-draft.pdf (for your review; non-signed).
- By 2027-06-10: signed bridge letter (finalized language + signatures) — if procurement needs an executed letter for their file before the PO cutoff.

Action items for Acme Health: please confirm the exact coverage date you need on the bridge (your note suggested 2027-08-31) and whether procurement requires language referencing specific control families or just a high-level coverage statement. Also confirm the PO cutoff date so we can align legal and sign-off timelines.

Cc’ing Rachel (security/compliance) and Marissa (customer success) to help with artifact mapping and legal coordination.

Attachments: [soc2-type2-2025.pdf (pdf, 6.2MB)], [procurement-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)]

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 docs for renewal — coverage question

Thanks Ben — a few clarifying points from procurement: 

- The renewal we’re processing needs assurance that there is no unmitigated audit gap between your last Type II (2025 period) and the contract start date. Acme’s security gate will accept either a bridge letter explicitly covering through 2027-08-31 or a signed interim attestation that references the control families we require (access control, change management, incident response).
- PO cutoff: 2027-06-15 is our internal procurement cutoff to have contracts signed and POs issued for the Q3 renewal ramp. If Redwood can provide the signed bridge by 2027-06-10 we will accept that for the file while the final Type II report is still in process.

Can you confirm the requested language below would work? If yes, we’ll confirm with Legal: 

"Redwood Inference confirms that controls reported in the SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31 remain in place and operated effectively through 2027-08-31. This letter is provided as interim coverage for Acme Health for procurement purposes and is not a replacement for the formal SOC 2 report once issued."

If you prefer to supply a signed attestation referencing the three control families explicitly, that would also work — please advise which path you prefer.

Regards,
Acme Procurement Team
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 docs for renewal — coverage question

Hi Lisa / procurement team — thanks for the suggested language, that is helpful and roughly matches the wording our legal/compliance team prefers. We can proceed with the bridge letter path and will include explicit reference to the three control families you called out. Plan: 

- Rachel will circulate a signed bridge letter (final PDF) to your procurement mailbox by 2027-06-10 at the latest.
- Prior to that, by 2027-06-03 we’ll share interim-attestation-draft.pdf (non-signed) for Acme Legal to review and confirm language. Attachment: interim-attestation-draft.pdf (sample wording + controls callout).
- If Acme needs anything added to the bridge (e.g., a mention of subservice organizations or data residency), flag it now so we can incorporate into the draft.

Please note the bridge is intended for procurement assurance only and will explicitly state it is not a substitute for a future SOC 2 Type II report covering the subsequent period. If that’s acceptable, Ben will coordinate sign-off after Rachel’s compliance review and Marissa’s CS confirmation.

Attachment: [interim-attestation-draft.pdf (pdf, 24KB)]

Next steps: Lisa — confirm the 2027-08-31 coverage date and whether procurement wants any additional call-outs. If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call next week to walk Acme Legal through the draft.

Thanks,
Ben

From: Lisa Nguyen <lisa.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 docs for renewal — coverage question

Ben — this looks good and Acme procurement is comfortable proceeding on the bridge letter path. Confirming: coverage date 2027-08-31. We will expect the signed bridge by 2027-06-10 and will aim to have the PO in place by the 2027-06-15 cutoff.

Please schedule the 20-minute review call with Acme Legal for the week of 2027-05-31 — Tuesday or Wednesday morning PST would be best. Marissa / Rachel — let us know if you want a brief pre-call to align on language.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — attaching this thread to our renewal ticket.

Best,
Lisa
